source.title: Ab initio intermolecular potential energy surface for the CO2-N2 system and related thermophysical properties
source.authors: J.-P. Crusius, R. Hellmann, J. C. Castro-Palacio, V. Vesovic
source.physical_scope: Dilute gas, rigid CO2 and N2 molecules, correlation to equimolar diffusion; composition dependence less than0.5percent is omitted. Not a porous diffusivity or dense-gas model.

source_uncertainty.kind: authors combined standard uncertainty, not a hard error bound

review.comparison_budget_basis: Declared2percent comparison screen for one-standard-uncertainty predictions and viscosity-derived effective diffusion. Not a formal combined uncertainty or direct experimental certification.
